# sharp libvips notice sources

The locked `@img/sharp-libvips-*` 1.3.4 packages declare LGPL-3.0-or-later
but omit LICENSE files from their npm archives. Their matching upstream notices
are preserved from https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/blob/v1.3.4/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
The LGPL and GPL texts are from https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt and
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt. The notices list additional component
licenses; this source inventory does not replace a distributed-binary audit or
the corresponding-source and relinking requirements of those licenses.

Terminal palettes use the Catppuccin palette and its MIT copyright notice from
https://github.com/catppuccin/palette, retrieved 2026-10-16. The ANSI mapping is
Morphz's; it is not an official Catppuccin xterm port.
